Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing a farm worker-grower advisory committee.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to establishing a farm workergrower advisorycommittee; and adding a new section to chapter 43.23 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.23 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The director shall appoint a farm workergrower advisorycommittee composed of ten members: Four representing farm workers; four representing growers; and two nonvoting ex officio members, onerepresenting the commissioner of the employment security department and one representing the director. The member representing the directorshall be the chair of the committee. (2) The committee shall aid the director in formulating policiesand discussing problems related to agricultural labor. The committeeshall provide comment on department rule making, policies, and otherinitiatives related to agricultural labor. The committee shall alsoconduct a continuing study of any aspect of agricultural labor thecommittee determines to require its consideration. The committee shallreport its findings to the department or the employment securitydepartment for action as deemed appropriate. p. 1 HB 2554 (3) The members of the committee shall be appointed for a term offour years commencing July 1, 2010, and the terms of the membersrepresenting the farm workers and growers shall be staggered so thatthe director shall designate one member from each such group initiallyappointed whose term shall expire June 30, 2011, one member from eachsuch group whose term shall expire June 30, 2012, and one member fromeach such group whose term shall expire June 30, 2013. (4) The members of the committee shall serve without compensation,but shall be entitled to travel expenses as provided in RCW 43.03.050and 43.03.060. (5) The committee may hire such experts, if any, as it shallrequire to discharge its duties, and may use such personnel andfacilities of the department and the employment security department asit shall need without charge. (6) The expenses of the committee shall be paid by the department.
